question: Which 2D EMD configuration/backend gives the most meaningful multiscale decomposition of these MRI images, and why?

recommended_protocol.preprocess: zero-pad to square max(H,W), run BEMD, crop components back to native FOV
recommended_protocol.why_pad: Native non-square CMR frames crash BEMD extrema indexing (IndexError). Square pad avoids the bug.

rationale: EMD2D cannot produce >1 BIMF on synthetic or MRI under any tested threshold/FIXE settings because the residue after BIMF0 has 0 extrema under the 3x3 detector. BEMD with square padding yields 4 BIMFs on 8/8 MRI probes (~15s/slice), near-perfect reconstruction, and often (not always) decreasing spectral centroids. This is the only true-2D option that enables a genuine BIMF0..k + residual component sweep. Caveat: PyEMD marks BEMD experimental; centroid monotonicity is imperfect (~3/8 fully mono).

emd2d_tuned.failure_mode: same extrema stop; stricter thr does not create later BIMFs

bemd_native_nonsquare.failure_mode: IndexError in envelope sampling on non-square arrays

bemd_square_pad.failure_mode: experimental API; pad may introduce weak edge artifacts
